The plate measures about 355 px across, so I treated it as a roughly 26 cm dinner plate, which gives about 13.6 px per cm.

The pizza slice is about 200 px long and about 120 px wide, which works out to roughly 14 cm by 8 cm. It looks like a rectangular slice of focaccia-style pizza, probably 1.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 14 × 8 × 1.5 = 168 cm³. Bread-like dough is airy, so I assumed a density of about 0.5 g/cm³, which puts the slice at roughly 85–100 g.

At about 2.7 kcal/g for pizza, 95 g comes to around 260 kcal.
